screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Released after manual policy-v13 review of a no-finding budget hold. The cited no_record_clause (src/baseline.rs:1196-1223, 1466-1474) swaps the miner's own no-record prompt clause for request-specific wording; it is prompt text only, the same routed-guidance pattern released on Harry v30 (october-23-routed-guidance). The answer slot is parsed from the model's own content (baseline.rs:2879), and final_text is that content plus typography (baseline.rs:4531-4533). bench_version appears only in a protocol test. No I1-I8 or S1-S3 ground.
